question: In the ANOVA of the bio-gas yield model for teak leaf pyrolysis, what F-value does temperature have?
rendered:
According to the excerpt "[Production of Medium-Grade Fuel from Pyrolysis of Teak Tree Leaves, page 4]", the ANOVA table for bio-gas yield is shown as follows:

Response 3: Bio Gas (%) Df Mean Square F-value
8 42.21 111.90
4 55.90 148.17
4 28.53 75.62
16 0.3773 24
p-value < 0.0001 < 0.0001 < 0.0001

Since temperature has 4 degrees of freedom, the F-value for temperature is 148.17.
